answer: Each identity claims one harbor work-slot and locks 80 credits as bond. Each epoch it files a pulse log of signed canyon receipts. An auditor replays each pulse on the public canyon work table; a mismatched, reused, or copied log burns it, so one key cannot feed a rented-slot ring. First slot 40, k-th 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 and lock 80,000 for a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 40 once and keeps its bond.
